defects: Uses `Ideal.Prime` (the multiplicative-monoid notion, which excludes the zero ideal since Prime elements must be nonzero) instead of `Ideal.IsPrime`; this is a strictly stronger/different hypothesis than gold's `P.IsPrime` instance (and the implicitly-derived primality of `p`), incorrectly ruling out the valid case where the base or lying-over ideal is the zero ideal in a domain.

Replaces the 'lies over' relation (`P.LiesOver p`, equivalent to `Q.comap (algebraMap R S) = P`) with a strictly weaker one-directional containment `Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) P ≤ Q`; this does not force Q to lie over P and does not guarantee a well-defined residue-field extension/module structure, so the conclusion need not correspond to the actual inertia degree.

Conclusion is rephrased as `FiniteDimensional.finrank` of residue fields of `Localization.AtPrime` at P and Q rather than gold's dedicated `inertiaDeg'` function; this reformulation is only equivalent to the intended inertia degree when the (missing) exact lying-over condition holds.
